statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient is being evaluated for potential arrhythmias
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying cardiac rhythm disturbances
The diagnosis codes are Z86.73 and R00.2
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
The service is medically necessary for this patient
